directAnswer: eVOA and standard VOA both allow up to 30 days, with one extension to a total of 60 days. eVOA is arranged before travel; VOA is obtained on arrival. eVOA settles the visa question in advance, avoids the airport VOA payment step and can allow autogate use when the requirements are met.
